data.body: Gerrit change 2851 patch set 1 reached LLM-Review +1 with zero unresolved comments, but CI run 34280297343 failed in the py3.13 gating cell. The sole failure was tests/unit/test_ci_workflow_parity.py::test_sweep_extra_parity_would_have_caught_c57057f41: the test invokes git show c57057f41:.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml while the Gerrit checkout is fetch-depth 1, so the historical object is absent. CI otherwise reported 20,171 passed and 82 skipped. This is deterministic and independent of the comment-only patch, so no blind recheck was requested. Filed porcine-epicentral-cuscus for the separate debug session and linked it as this ticket’s blocker.
